cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(MapLibreFillExtrusion LANGUAGES CXX)

# Consume only the C header from the SDK AAR, never another copy of mbgl-core.
find_package(MapLibreAndroid REQUIRED CONFIG)
get_filename_component(PLUGIN_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../../plugins/fill-extrusion" ABSOLUTE)

add_library(fill-extrusion-core STATIC
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/cpp/fill_extrusion.cpp"
)
target_compile_features(fill-extrusion-core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(fill-extrusion-core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(fill-extrusion-core PUBLIC
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/include"
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/cpp"
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/vendor"
)
target_link_libraries(fill-extrusion-core PUBLIC MapLibreAndroid::maplibre)

add_library(fill-extrusion SHARED plugin.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fill-extrusion PRIVATE fill-extrusion-core dl)
